$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFHO (AIP France, chart dated 2024-08-08): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Aubenas Ardèche méridionale

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for radio equipped ACFT Preferred QFU 002° due to environment.
LDG RWY 18: do not descend below 1000 ft AAL until lining up on final APCH.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
Caution advised when taxiing due to presence of civil safety equipment close to the TWY.
TWY civil protection is unusable when pelicandrome is active.
Parallel TWY reserved as a priority for Civil Safety ACFT.
South hangars service way: maximum wingspan of 12 meters, maximum landing gear width of 4 meters.
Avoid overflying Balazuc located south of AD.
PCL: 3 clicks on mic: edge lighting, windsock, signs, PAPI,; 5 clicks on mic: edge lighting, windsock, signs, flashing lights,; 7 clicks on mic: shutdown.
PJE on AD (NR 412): FL 135; SAT, SUN and public HOL; Daytime except when LF-R 55 C or D are active.
Aerobatics over AD (NR 6810): when LF-R 55 D is inactive: 2600 ft AMSL / FL 060; HJ on SAT, SUN and public HOL, PPR from ORANGE APP 118.925.
AEM on AD (NR 9635): 500 ft ASFC, SR-SS.
